relay.session.tags.action.role: long-press action sheet entry that opens the tag sheet
relay.session.tags.action.tone: Sentence-ish label, the ellipsis is U+2026 and means a sheet opens.
relay.session.tags.action.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Rendered only when capabilities.session_tags.available is true; the row itself never carries tag controls.

relay.session.tags.sheet_title.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The conversation's name is deliberately not repeated here: the action sheet that opened this one already named it.

relay.session.tags.empty.tone: lowercase; no advice, the hint below carries it.
relay.session.tags.empty.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Shown only when the catalogue resolved and has no entries; the phone cannot create categories.

relay.session.tags.empty_hint.role: empty-catalogue hint naming the surfaces that own category identity
relay.session.tags.empty_hint.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Category create/rename deliberately lives in the desktop app and agent callers, not the phone.

relay.session.tags.load_error.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Paired with the retry control; the daemon's own refusal is not shown here because the read carries none.

relay.session.tags.retry.role: re-read the catalogue after a failure

relay.session.tags.limit_hint.role: explains why unchecked categories are disabled at the cap
relay.session.tags.limit_hint.tone: Sentence, em dash, {count} is the relay's cap.
relay.session.tags.limit_hint.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Also the aria-describedby target of every disabled row, so the reason is audible, not only visible.

relay.session.tags.primary.role: screen-reader word beside the row's leading dot
relay.session.tags.primary.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The primary mark is a shape plus this word, never colour alone.

relay.session.tags.make_primary.role: accessible name of a selected row's primary radio
relay.session.tags.make_primary.tone: lowercase, {name} is the category's own name.
relay.session.tags.make_primary.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The radio itself is mark-only; this sentence is what a screen reader hears.

relay.session.tags.more.role: accessible name of the row's +N mark
relay.session.tags.more.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The visible mark is only +N, so this is the whole sentence assistive tech gets.

relay.session.tags.missing.role: note beside an assigned category absent from the registry
relay.session.tags.missing.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Such a row stays selectable so the reader can remove an assignment the catalogue can no longer explain.

relay.session.tags.saving.role: per-row pending mark while an assignment write is in flight

relay.session.tags.save_error.role: refusal lead for a rejected assignment write
relay.session.tags.save_error.tone: Sentence case, no terminal punctuation: the daemon's own sentence follows after a colon.
relay.session.tags.save_error.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Shared refusal hygiene (lib/refusal) appends the relay's sentence, which is written for this reader and passes through unrewritten.

relay.session.tags.remove_all.role: first press of the two-step clear
relay.session.tags.remove_all.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Turns into the confirm pair; no write happens on this press.

relay.session.tags.remove_all_confirm.role: the confirmation press that clears the assignment
relay.session.tags.remove_all_confirm.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Sends the exact empty desired state {tags: [], primary: null}.

relay.session.tags.cancel.role: inline confirm's cancel button in the remove-all row
relay.session.tags.cancel.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Cancels the pending remove-all confirmation and writes nothing.

relay.session.tags.done.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Closes the sheet; every assignment already landed as its own write.

relay.session.tags.pin_and_tags_hint.role: long-press discoverer when the relay also serves tags
relay.session.tags.pin_and_tags_hint.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase. Names both verbs a long-press offers.
relay.session.tags.pin_and_tags_hint.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Rendered only when capabilities.session_tags.available is true; relays without the tag routes keep the pin-only sentence, so the hint never promises a screen this build cannot serve.
